body:
Hearts and Minds Books is a one-of-a-kind. I have such great respect for Byron Borger and the whole H & M team. They are offering my new book Faith After Doubt at a 20% discount, and they will include a signed bookplate with each order received by year’s end.

 I hope you’ll consider ordering from Hearts and Minds – here’s the link.
